objective: 冻结R61全局max/min两流并发修正公式，在四个完全未参与拟合的模型KV布局上运行生产Mooncake RDMA物理测量，并与已通过的R62合并形成六模型证据。
execution_model: external topology inventory; 48 auditable three-rank GPU shards; frozen-model CPU aggregation with no fitting

research_scope.wave_admission: all three ranks and both transfers are ready before synchronized release
research_scope.decision_scope: none; model layout, P/D counts, routing, payload and placement are frozen inputs

frozen_correction_contract.formula: max(1.0, intercept_us + beta_max * max(C0,C1) + beta_min * min(C0,C1))
frozen_correction_contract.runtime_inputs: C0/C1 are frozen Phase51 official P1D1 curve interpolations for the two payloads
forbidden: using matched-solo or Phase63 targets as an inference input

external_payload_contract.selection_policy: six symmetric and four asymmetric pairs at pre-existing Phase51 knots, frozen in W63 before any Phase63 raw exists
external_payload_contract.target_opening_policy: pair identities and payloads are known from Phase51 single-flow curves; Phase63 concurrent-wave targets are unopened and forbidden until W63 is frozen

topology_definitions.L1: one physical node, three launched GPU ranks per shard
topology_definitions.L2: two physical nodes in one rack/network domain, three launched GPU ranks per shard
topology_definitions.L3: two physical nodes in different racks but one RDMA domain, three launched GPU ranks per shard

resource_allocation_contract.endpoint_slots: A0/A1/B0/B1 are four GPU slots, not four nodes
resource_allocation_contract.topology_allocation_epochs: L1, L2 and L3 may use separate sequential scheduler allocations; inventory may name more than two hosts across the whole experiment but no allocation may contain more than two active nodes
resource_allocation_contract.replica_execution: replica0 and replica1 execute sequentially and may reuse the same node/node-pair with distinct GPU tuples
resource_allocation_contract.scheduling: exactly one measurement shard at a time; models, topologies, configurations, replicas and repeats are all sequential outside the two concurrent flows inside that shard

placement_contract.replacement_policy: if Phase62 endpoints cannot be allocated, choose same-class GPU/RDMA endpoints from scheduler asset and rack/fabric metadata before raw; never benchmark then select
placement_contract.replicas_distinct: the two endpoint signatures within each topology must differ
placement_contract.selection_source: scheduler/asset host, rack and fabric metadata only; never Phase63 latency or frozen-model error
placement_contract.claim_boundary: model-layout external validation across the measured placements; exact Phase62-placement isolation is reported separately when achieved

transport_contract.concurrent_call_policy: P1D2 has one shared engine with two worker threads; P2D1 has one sender engine per P rank

measurement_contract.wave_latency_semantic: maximum sender-side synchronous call latency across the two concurrently admitted flows
measurement_contract.data_validation: outside timed intervals verify every destination byte after each mode
measurement_contract.official_point_policy: median across repeats inside each replica, then maximum actual concurrent latency across the two pre-frozen replicas
measurement_contract.raw_storage: all JSONL and per-iteration samples remain outside Git

external_validation_gate.selection: mechanical evaluation only; failure is retained honestly and never triggers refit on Phase63 labels

container_contract.required_gpu_class: CUDA GPU with GPUDirect RDMA; NVIDIA A51 B200 is acceptable

claim_boundary: Phase63 is physical external-model validation of the frozen R61 correction for exactly two flows in P1D2/P2D1
a Phase63 PASS plus pinned R62 PASS supports six-model evidence across measured L1/L2/L3 and placements
it does not support P2D2, more flows, end-to-end serving, compute, memory, queueing, unrelated-job congestion, online arrivals or scheduling
stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not exact W63 or any pinned input differs
any prior validated model replaces one of the four held-out models or any R61 coefficient/threshold is changed
payload pairs or topology inventory are edited after Phase63 raw begins, or placement is selected by observed speed/error
an executor requests more than two simultaneous nodes in any allocation or runs two measurement shards concurrently
production Mooncake RDMA/dma-buf is unavailable or falls back to TCP, MNNVL, NVLink bypass, staging or custom pool
model weights, inference, training, downloads, protected raw/cache/PID assets are accessed
raw would enter Git or an existing Phase63 result directory would be overwritten
